micPermission.title: Microphone Access
micPermission.bodyNoName: This site wants to use your microphone

micBlocked.title: MICROPHONE BLOCKED
micBlocked.body: To record your voice, we need access to your microphone. If you do not wish to record, feel free to wander and listen!

audioRequired.title: AUDIO REQUIRED
audioRequired.body: We notice that your device doesn't allow for audio experiences. This is a music project that requires audio, so please plug in speakers and a mic or try on a different device. Thanks!

locationNotFound.title: LOCATION NOT FOUND!
locationNotFound.body: Sorry we couldn't find your location. Please refresh your browser and try again.

permissionDenied.title: NO LOCATION ACCESS!
permissionDenied.body: To participate fully in the artwork experience we need access to your location. Please enable location access in your browser.

android.step1: 1. Tap the three dots menu (⋮) in the top right corner of your browser
android.step3: 3. Scroll down and find "Site settings" (usually at the bottom)
android.step6: 6. Go back and refresh the page

iosAa.step1: 1. Tap the <icon/> button on the bottom

iosPageMenu.step1: 1. Click on the <icon/> icon at bottom left
iosPageMenu.step2: 2. Click on the Three dots (⋮) menu
iosPageMenu.step6: 6. Click on "Done" at the top & refresh the page

iosSettings.step1: 1. Open the Settings app on your iPhone/iPad
iosSettings.step3: 3. Scroll to the bottom and find the "Settings for Websites" section
iosSettings.step6: 6. Return to your browser and refresh the page

chrome.step1: 1. Click the site controls icon <icon/> next to the URL.

edge.step1: 1. Click the site controls <icon/> lock icon next to the website URL at the top.

firefox.step1: 1. Click the three lines menu (☰) in the top right
firefox.step2: 2. Go to Settings > Privacy & Security > Permissions > {{permission}}
firefox.step5: 5. Refresh the page and try again

safari.step2: 2. Find this website in the list
safari.step4: 4. Refresh the page and try again

other.step4: 4. Find this website and change it from 'Block' to 'Allow'
other.step5: 5. Refresh the page and try again

error.generic: Something went wrong! Please try again.
error.connection: Sorry, we were unable to connect to Roundware. Please try again.
